name: Glowing Peptides
legalEntity: ISAD E-COMMERCE SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ (KRS 0001221796; NIP 7812104791; shop-listed VAT PL7812104791)
coaAccess: Selected product pages link Google Drive copies; QR links on 4 sampled copies opened matching original reports on Janoshik's domain.
dispatchInfo: The shop states dispatch from Poland via tracked DHL eCommerce Poland to 41 destinations, with 1–2 working days of processing after payment and estimated transit of 1–3 working days in Poland, 2–3 to Germany and 2–9 elsewhere.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: All 4 selected copies from 3 product pages matched original lab reports, but no public report links were found on the BPC-157, TB-500 or Triple G pages read.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 4 tested samples contained 101.2–105.2% of nominal content; current stock was not sampled.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The opened sheets show measured content and purity but do not specify analytical methods or show separate identity, endotoxin, sterility or heavy-metal results.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The Polish KRS register confirms the named company and registration number, but its registered street address differs from the one on the shop's terms and privacy page.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The written policy gives a tracked carrier, delivery estimates and a free-shipping threshold, but its 20:00 same-day statement and 1–2 working days after payment are not reconciled.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: At regular prices for equal nominal 10 mg vials, BPC-157, Selank and Semax were below their medians in our existing EUR sample; TB-500 was slightly above its median.

strengths: All 4 sampled Google Drive copies matched the product, client and batch on the original Janoshik reports.
All 4 tested samples measured within 101.2–105.2% of nominal content.
The named seller and registration number match the official Polish company register.
weaknesses: No public report links found on the BPC-157, TB-500 or Triple G product pages reviewed; the 4 confirmed reports do not establish coverage for the catalog.
Glutathion batch C119 measured 98.592% purity, below the product page's claim of over 99%.
The shop lists a different Poznań street address from the current KRS extract; no link from the reports to current stock batches was established.
verdict: The Polish register confirms the seller's identity, although its registered street address differs from the shop's. All 4 sampled reports were readable on Janoshik's domain and matched their shop-linked copies. One Glutathion batch was below the advertised purity threshold, and the sampled reports do not establish the batch of any item currently in stock.
summary: Research-use shop whose terms name ISAD E-COMMERCE SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ. The shop says it ships from Poland and links lab reports from selected product pages.
notes: The official KRS extract records ul. Wolsztyńska 5, 60-361 Poznań; the shop's terms and privacy page give ul. Juliusza Słowackiego 55/1, 60-521 Poznań. The shop's Słubice return address is separate and does not establish warehouse location. The shipping policy and terms say free shipping from €100; the English BPC-157 page instead displays a banner reading Orders <100€. The published Wallid option is limited to Spain, France, Belgium, Ireland, Portugal and the Netherlands. The 4 reports cover 3 products, including 2 Glutathion batches; matching the identifiers on the shop-linked copies to the originals does not match any batch to current stock. The product pages label the files as PDFs, but the sampled Drive downloads were PNGs. Prices and stocks are snapshots for 5 public individual variants confirmed through the shop's Store API; no multi-buy discount or checkout was tested. The EUR comparison uses regular, in-stock prices for equal vial sizes in the existing audit dataset; it excludes Glutathion for lack of a comparator. Triple G was not mapped to a compound or included in the price sample because the reviewed product pages did not explicitly name the compound.
